updateChannelNotRecorded: Infinitary could not record the update's channel, so nothing was installed.
updateDownloadChecksum: The download did not match its published checksum, so nothing was installed.
updateDownloadNoWrite: Infinitary cannot write in {folder}. Move the app to a folder you own, such as your home folder, and try again.
updateDownloadRefused: The download did not start (the server answered {status}). Try again later.
updateDownloadStopped: The download stopped before it finished. Try again.
updateDownloadUnreachable: Infinitary could not reach the download. Check your connection and try again.
updateInstallerNoStart: The installer could not start, so nothing was installed.
updateWindowsChannelNotPutBack: Infinitary could not put back the update channel it followed before, so check the channel in Settings → General.
updateWindowsInstallFailed: The installer stopped before it finished, so this copy was kept.
updateWindowsNoCopy: Infinitary could not open again after its update. Download the installer from {page} and run it; your tasks and settings are kept.
updateWindowsShutdownTimeout: Infinitary took more than five minutes to close, so the update stopped and nothing was installed.
